title: Regulated-Material Fee in the Insurance Claim Services Mold Protocol Supplement
content:
**Rule.** In the Insurance Claim Services protocol supplement, the regulated-material fee is priced as follows: on a file that carries no ordinance-or-law limit, for growth in a living area or basement of housing (a single-family house, condominium unit or multifamily unit) built before the tier's RRP year-built cutoff, the tier's lead-safe setup fee plus its asbestos sampling fee, because removal there disturbs painted surfaces in target housing under the EPA Renovation, Repair and Painting Rule and the building also predates the asbestos sampling year cutoff; on a file that carries no ordinance-or-law limit, for any other growth outside the HVAC system in a building built before the tier's asbestos sampling year cutoff, the tier's asbestos sampling fee alone, because the suspect materials are sampled while lead-safe work is priced only with finished living spaces and basements; otherwise no regulated-material fee, because on a file with an ordinance-or-law limit the regulated-material work of a mold job is claimed as a code upgrade supplement under that limit rather than against the mold sublimit, which caps every mold supplement, and HVAC cleaning disturbs no regulated material.

The ordinance-or-law limit is the claim file's; property type, year built, growth location and tier are those of the Mold Remediation job awaiting clearance. On every Mold Remediation tier the RRP year-built cutoff is 1978 (built 1977 or earlier is before it) and the asbestos sampling year cutoff is 1981 (built 1980 or earlier is before it).

## Truth table

| Ordinance-or-law limit on the file | Growth location | Property | Year built | Fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| none | living area or basement | housing | 1977 or earlier | lead-safe setup fee plus asbestos sampling fee |
| none | living area or basement | housing | 1978 to 1980 | asbestos sampling fee alone |
| none | living area or basement | commercial | 1980 or earlier | asbestos sampling fee alone |
| none | attic or crawlspace | any | 1980 or earlier | asbestos sampling fee alone |
| none | any outside the HVAC system | any | 1981 or later | none |
| none | HVAC system | any | any | none |
| a limit is carried | any | any | any | none |
